newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks continue firm in London.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks continue firm in London.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were slightly higher on Tuesday in light trading, with the Hang Seng London Reference Index extending the Hang Seng's upward trend.
The London reference index climbed 30.70 points to close at 12,521.40. Earlier, in Hong Kong the Hang Seng index had closed up 160.35 points at 12,490.70, its third record in three days.

In London HSBC shares were the only point of interest in a dull market, traders said. They closed at HK$ 152.4, up 90 HK cents on their HK$ 151.5 Hong Kong close, tracking gains in the UK's FTSE-100 index.
"The market tried a rally after Wall Street opened but it did not come to anything," said one trader.
Hong Kong stocks are expected on Wednesday to continue tracking Wall Street and the U.S. long bond, traders said.
